sentences.s: 他从窗帘后出来了。
sentences.t: 他從窗簾後出來了。
sentences.en: He came out from behind the curtain.

sentences.s: 我的祖父早起。
sentences.t: 我的祖父早起。
sentences.en: My grandfather gets up early.

sentences.s: 那是唯一的出路。
sentences.t: 那是唯一的出路。
sentences.en: It was the only way to go.

sentences.s: 这个男孩子很懒。
sentences.t: 這個男孩子很懶。
sentences.en: This boy is very lazy.

sentences.s: 坚持做对的事情。这会满足一部分人同时使另一部分人感到惊讶。
sentences.t: 堅持做對的事情。這會滿足一部分人同時使另一部分人感到驚訝。
sentences.en: Always do right. This will gratify some people and astonish the rest.

sentences.s: 我在打开包装时遇到了麻烦。
sentences.t: 我在打開包裝時遇到了麻煩。
sentences.en: I had trouble unwrapping the package.

sentences.s: 美式厨房比日式的大。
sentences.t: 美式廚房比日式的大。
sentences.en: American kitchens are much bigger than Japanese ones.

sentences.s: 这正是问题的关键。
sentences.t: 這正是問題的關鍵。
sentences.en: That's the point.

sentences.s: 我来警告你别那样做。
sentences.t: 我來警告你別那樣做。
sentences.en: I came to warn you not to do that.

sentences.s: 从国际的观点看，应该考虑推行人口政策来平衡两方的利益。
sentences.t: 從國際的觀點看，應該考慮推行人口政策來平衡兩方的利益。
sentences.en: A population policy should be considered on the international viewpoint so as to balance the interests of both sides.

sentences.s: 请在下方留言。
sentences.t: 請在下方留言。
sentences.en: Please leave a comment below.

sentences.s: 我们肯定他会成功。
sentences.t: 我們肯定他會成功。
sentences.en: We are sure of his success.

sentences.s: 她会说法语。
sentences.t: 她會說法語。
sentences.en: She can speak French.

sentences.s: 这个实验室配备了最新的计算机。
sentences.t: 這個實驗室配備了最新的計算機。
sentences.en: This laboratory is equipped with the latest computers.

sentences.s: 我的鼻子没办法呼吸了。
sentences.t: 我的鼻子沒辦法呼吸了。
sentences.en: I can't breathe through my nose.

sentences.s: 他们不得不整天呆在家里。
sentences.t: 他們不得不整天呆在家裏。
sentences.en: They had to stay at home all day.

sentences.s: 我不怎么喜欢喝啤酒。
sentences.t: 我不怎麼喜歡喝啤酒。
sentences.en: I don't like drinking beer that much.

sentences.s: 他不是诗人；他写的是散文。
sentences.t: 他不是詩人；他寫的是散文。
sentences.en: He isn't a poet; he's a prose writer.

sentences.s: 他拿他的车和新款车作比较。
sentences.t: 他拿他的車和新款車作比較。
sentences.en: He compared his car to the new model.

sentences.s: 她企图自杀。
sentences.t: 她企圖自殺。
sentences.en: She attempted to kill herself.

sentences.s: 我到这里看看大家，一(来)是给大家送水果，二(来)是看看大家过节还有什么难处。
sentences.t: 我到這裏看看大家，一(來)是給大家送水果，二(來)是看看大家過節還有什麼難處。
sentences.en: I am here to see everyone, one [reason] is to bring fruit to everyone, another [reason] is to see if anyone has any difficulties over the holidays.

source.title: 一来(是)……二来(是)……
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 汤姆可能会在这里待几天。
sentences.t: 湯姆可能會在這裏待幾天。
sentences.en: Tom might be here for a couple of days.

sentences.s: 我打算随母姓。
sentences.t: 我打算隨母姓。
sentences.en: I'm planning to take my mother's maiden name.

sentences.s: 她在她的床上铺了床单。
sentences.t: 她在她的牀上鋪了牀單。
sentences.en: She put sheets on her bed.

sentences.s: 我必须向她道歉。
sentences.t: 我必須向她道歉。
sentences.en: I must make an apology to her.

sentences.s: 进了果园，大家看到一树的桃，红的红，绿的绿，漂亮极了。
sentences.t: 進了果園，大家看到一樹的桃，紅的紅，綠的綠，漂亮極了。
sentences.en: Entering the orchard, you can see a tree of peaches, some red, some green, very beautiful.

source.title: V/A1 的 V/A1，V/A2 的 V/A2
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我不会说日语。
sentences.t: 我不會說日語。
sentences.en: I couldn't speak Japanese.

sentences.s: 他背着重重的电脑包挤地铁，下班回到家累得什么似的。
sentences.t: 他揹着重重的電腦包擠地鐵，下班回到家累得什麼似的。
sentences.en: He squeezed into the [crowded] subway with [his] heavy computer bag, and he was so tired when he got home from work.

source.title: A 得什么似的
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 汤姆讨厌工作。
sentences.t: 湯姆討厭工作。
sentences.en: Tom hates working.

sentences.s: 现在我全都想起来了。
sentences.t: 現在我全都想起來了。
sentences.en: Now I recall (lit. think up) everything.

source.title: 想起来
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 那些材料都是可回收且可再利用的。
sentences.t: 那些材料都是可回收且可再利用的。
sentences.en: These materials are all reusable and recyclable.

sentences.s: 一杯冷水在暑热的天气里十分提神。
sentences.t: 一杯冷水在暑熱的天氣裏十分提神。
sentences.en: A glass of cold water is very refreshing in hot weather.

sentences.s: 他的形象全毁了。
sentences.t: 他的形象全毀了。
sentences.en: His image is completely ruined.

sentences.s: 为什么我要向你道歉？
sentences.t: 爲什麼我要向你道歉？
sentences.en: Why should I apologize to you?

sentences.s: 我肯定这是淡水鱼。
sentences.t: 我肯定這是淡水魚。
sentences.en: I'm sure that this is a fresh water fish.

sentences.s: 短短的几分钟里，我的脑子里闪过了很多想法。
sentences.t: 短短的幾分鐘裏，我的腦子裏閃過了很多想法。
sentences.en: In as little as a few minutes, many thoughts flashed by my mind.

source.title: V 过
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 他是个捕鱼好手。
sentences.t: 他是個捕魚好手。
sentences.en: He is an expert at fishing.

sentences.s: 他最近好像瘦了。
sentences.t: 他最近好像瘦了。
sentences.en: It seems he's gotten thinner lately.

sentences.s: 那台电脑中毒了。
sentences.t: 那臺電腦中毒了。
sentences.en: The computer has a virus.

sentences.s: 干了几天，小王就不想干了。大家没办法，只得暂且由他去。
sentences.t: 幹了幾天，小王就不想幹了。大家沒辦法，只得暫且由他去。
sentences.en: After a few days, Xiao Wang didn't want to work [that job] anymore. Everyone had no choice but to leave him for the time being.

source.title: 暂且
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我没办法控制自己身体的动作了。
sentences.t: 我沒辦法控制自己身體的動作了。
sentences.en: I can't control my body's movements anymore.

sentences.s: 公司缺少领导团队。
sentences.t: 公司缺少領導團隊。
sentences.en: The company lacks leadership.

sentences.s: 我打算待在旅馆里。
sentences.t: 我打算待在旅館裏。
sentences.en: I'm planning to stay at the hotel.

sentences.s: 他没有选择，只能辞职。
sentences.t: 他沒有選擇，只能辭職。
sentences.en: He has no choice but to resign.

sentences.s: 她的脸上露出了阳光般的笑容。
sentences.t: 她的臉上露出了陽光般的笑容。
sentences.en: Her face showed a sunny (lit. like sunlight) smile.

source.title: N 般
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 她不喜欢让自己丈夫喝醉。
sentences.t: 她不喜歡讓自己丈夫喝醉。
sentences.en: She didn't like her husband drunk.

sentences.s: 把车停在这里是违法的。
sentences.t: 把車停在這裏是違法的。
sentences.en: It's illegal to park your car here.

sentences.s: 出现非正常情况时请不要紧张。
sentences.t: 出現非正常情況時請不要緊張。
sentences.en: Please do not be nervous when emergencies (lit. abnormal conditions) occur.

source.title: 非
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 据说，他年轻时曾经一个人去过非洲大森林。
sentences.t: 據說，他年輕時曾經一個人去過非洲大森林。
sentences.en: It is said that at one time he went to the great forest in Africa when he was young.

source.title: 据说……
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 直到今天，我也不明白他当时为什么发那么大脾气。
sentences.t: 直到今天，我也不明白他當時爲什麼發那麼大脾氣。
sentences.en: Until today, I don’t understand why he had such a bad temper at the time.

source.title: 直到
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 笑谈之中有至理。
sentences.t: 笑談之中有至理。
sentences.en: Many a true word is spoken in jest.

sentences.s: 我知道超出我们的预算了，但是我就想买下来。
sentences.t: 我知道超出我們的預算了，但是我就想買下來。
sentences.en: I knew it was out of our price range, but I wanted to buy it anyway.

sentences.s: 我从不睡觉。
sentences.t: 我從不睡覺。
sentences.en: I never sleep.

sentences.s: 我每天搭火车上班。
sentences.t: 我每天搭火車上班。
sentences.en: I take the train to work every day.

sentences.s: 乘那辆巴士就可以到达动物园了。
sentences.t: 乘那輛巴士就可以到達動物園了。
sentences.en: That bus will take you to the zoo.

sentences.s: 除非再给我一个星期，否则我们无法完成任务。
sentences.t: 除非再給我一個星期，否則我們無法完成任務。
sentences.en: Unless you give me another week, (otherwise) we can't complete the task.

source.title: 除非……否则……
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 不就是一个空瓶子吗？扔掉算了。
sentences.t: 不就是一個空瓶子嗎？扔掉算了。
sentences.en: Isn't it just an empty bottle? Might as well throw it away.

source.title: V 了/掉 算了
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 他的工作是警察，写小说仅仅是他的业余爱好而已。
sentences.t: 他的工作是警察，寫小說僅僅是他的業餘愛好而已。
sentences.en: His works as a policeman, and writing novels is just his hobby (that’s all).

source.title: 仅仅/只不过……而已
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 如果你有时间的话，请过来一趟。
sentences.t: 如果你有時間的話，請過來一趟。
sentences.en: Please come over if you have time.

sentences.s: 谁告诉你们汤姆把腿摔断的？
sentences.t: 誰告訴你們湯姆把腿摔斷的？
sentences.en: Who told you Tom broke his leg?

sentences.s: 真理子英语说得很好。
sentences.t: 真理子英語說得很好。
sentences.en: Mariko speaks English well.

sentences.s: 你想待多久就待多久。
sentences.t: 你想待多久就待多久。
sentences.en: Please stay as long as you wish.

sentences.s: 台湾将维护自由。
sentences.t: 臺灣將維護自由。
sentences.en: Taiwan will remain free!

sentences.s: 我们能把门锁上吗？
sentences.t: 我們能把門鎖上嗎？
sentences.en: Can we lock this door?

sentences.s: 有谁想杀我？
sentences.t: 有誰想殺我？
sentences.en: Who would want to kill me?

sentences.s: 说真的，这次真是孩子给我上了一课。
sentences.t: 說真的，這次真是孩子給我上了一課。
sentences.en: Seriously, this time the child really gave me a lesson.

source.title: 说真的/说实在的
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 那对我没有用处。
sentences.t: 那對我沒有用處。
sentences.en: That is useless to me.

sentences.s: 我下个月将去澳洲。
sentences.t: 我下個月將去澳洲。
sentences.en: I will be leaving for Australia next month.

sentences.s: 趁电影还没开始，我去买两瓶矿泉水。
sentences.t: 趁電影還沒開始，我去買兩瓶礦泉水。
sentences.en: The movie hasn’t started, I’ll make use of the opportunity and get two bottles of mineral water.

source.title: 趁
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 你何必亲自送一趟呢？叫个快递不就行了？
sentences.t: 你何必親自送一趟呢？叫個快遞不就行了？
sentences.en: Why do you have to deliver it yourself? Calling a courier is not enough?

source.title: 何必
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我对我做过的事不后悔。
sentences.t: 我對我做過的事不後悔。
sentences.en: I have no regrets about what I did.

sentences.s: 他被竞争公司挖去了。
sentences.t: 他被競爭公司挖去了。
sentences.en: He was hired away by a rival company.

sentences.s: 鉴于农村教师严重缺乏，他决定大学毕业以后，到农村去当老师。
sentences.t: 鑑於農村教師嚴重缺乏，他決定大學畢業以後，到農村去當老師。
sentences.en: In view of the serious shortage of rural teachers, he decided to go to the countryside to become a teacher after graduating from college.

source.title: 鉴于
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 大家预先都没有想到，本届绘画展览竟然这么受欢迎。
sentences.t: 大家預先都沒有想到，本屆繪畫展覽竟然這麼受歡迎。
sentences.en: It was never expected (ahead of time) that this painting exhibition would be so popular.

source.title: 预先
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 同学们听了，发出一片热烈的欢呼声。
sentences.t: 同學們聽了，發出一片熱烈的歡呼聲。
sentences.en: The students listened and gave a (wave of) warm cheer.

source.title: 片
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 别总是为一点儿小事生气，不值/值得。
sentences.t: 別總是爲一點兒小事生氣，不值/值得。
sentences.en: Don't always be angry with a little thing, it’s not worth it.

source.title: 值/值得
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 一只老虎逃出了动物园。
sentences.t: 一隻老虎逃出了動物園。
sentences.en: A tiger has escaped from the zoo.

sentences.s: 他的羽毛球打得真厉害。
sentences.t: 他的羽毛球打得真厲害。
sentences.en: He plays badminton very well.

sentences.s: 市场上涨了半点。
sentences.t: 市場上漲了半點。
sentences.en: The market rose half a point.

sentences.s: 这个城市人口众多。
sentences.t: 這個城市人口衆多。
sentences.en: The city has a large population.

sentences.s: 我承认偷了钱。
sentences.t: 我承認偷了錢。
sentences.en: I confessed to stealing the money.

sentences.s: 他拔起杂草就扔掉。
sentences.t: 他拔起雜草就扔掉。
sentences.en: He pulled up the weed and threw it away.

sentences.s: 请告诉我我应该在哪里转换火车。
sentences.t: 請告訴我我應該在哪裏轉換火車。
sentences.en: Please tell me where I should change trains.

sentences.s: 我真的很想扁一个人。
sentences.t: 我真的很想扁一個人。
sentences.en: I really need to hit somebody.

sentences.s: 这些东西全都是你的吗？
sentences.t: 這些東西全都是你的嗎？
sentences.en: Are these all your belongings?

sentences.s: 对今天的中国而言，经济发展必须坚持走可持续发展的道路。
sentences.t: 對今天的中國而言，經濟發展必須堅持走可持續發展的道路。
sentences.en: For today's China, economic development must adhere to the path of sustainable development.

source.title: 对 N 而言
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 连运动员都不满意，更何况看比赛的球迷呢？
sentences.t: 連運動員都不滿意，更何況看比賽的球迷呢？
sentences.en: Even the athletes are not satisfied, let alone the fans watching the game?

source.title: (更)何况
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 他的处女作受到了大家的极大欢迎。
sentences.t: 他的處女作受到了大家的極大歡迎。
sentences.en: His first work gained great popularity among people.

sentences.s: 猜一下吧。汤姆和玛丽分手了。
sentences.t: 猜一下吧。湯姆和瑪麗分手了。
sentences.en: Guess what? Tom and Mary broke up.

sentences.s: 他很享受他的校园生活。
sentences.t: 他很享受他的校園生活。
sentences.en: He is enjoying his school life.

sentences.s: 他把壶盖儿打开，闻了闻，原来是酒。
sentences.t: 他把壺蓋兒打開，聞了聞，原來是酒。
sentences.en: He opened the lid of the pot and smelled it. It turned out to be alcohol.

source.title: 闻
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 他们看起来喝醉了。
sentences.t: 他們看起來喝醉了。
sentences.en: They look as if they're drunk.

sentences.s: 干工作不能光凭经验，还要有创新。
sentences.t: 幹工作不能光憑經驗，還要有創新。
sentences.en: When we work, we can’t just rely on experience, we also need to innovate.

sentences.t: 我們的結論就是，那個傳言是真的。
sentences.en: We've come to the conclusion that this is a true story.

sentences.t: 飛來一隻蒼蠅，人動手去打，卻總是打不中。
sentences.en: A fly flew in. People tried to hit it with their hands but always missed it.

sentences.en: I'm sorry to cause you all this trouble.

sentences.en: He knocked on the door.

sentences.en: I didn't have more than 1,000 yen.

sentences.en: This house is haunted.

sentences.en: Please sign here.

sentences.en: This booklet is free of charge.

sentences.s: 我们会礼貌的问。

sentences.en: We'll ask politely.

sentences.s: 你们这样做有法律依据吗？

sentences.en: Do you have any legal basis for doing so?

source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 才不呢，我想他那样做只不过是想哄老婆高兴。
